deliverables.purpose: 帆布袋主视觉正面实物图；以 official-idvx-logo 为核心识别，通过 image_edit 落到真实袋型。
deliverables.acceptance_test: Official logo legible and unchanged; uses tongji-blue, deep-ink, paper-white, signal-coral; baked bilingual merchandise title uses headline + caption roles.

deliverables.purpose: 帆布袋细节或背面视图，展示 Campus Data Grid 纹样、肩带或局部结构。
deliverables.acceptance_test: Shows Campus Data Grid in a restrained way; official-idvx-logo still sourced from reference; uses paper-white, deep-ink, steel-grid, tongji-blue; caption/mono hierarchy clear.

deliverables.purpose: 笔记本封面主视图，展示实验室全称与学院式封面版式。
deliverables.acceptance_test: Notebook cover cites official naming, uses tongji-blue, deep-ink, paper-white, steel-grid, and applies display + headline + caption with restrained grid discipline.

deliverables.purpose: 笔记本打开视图，展示内页索引、页眉与研究记录语境。
deliverables.acceptance_test: Open spread uses paper-white, deep-ink, steel-grid, campus-green and body + caption + mono roles; page system feels academic and contains no fake lorem or乱码 text.

deliverables.purpose: 徽章系列集合图，展示至少三枚变体与统一工艺逻辑。
deliverables.acceptance_test: At least one badge uses official-idvx-logo intact; uses tongji-blue, paper-white, deep-ink, signal-coral; all badge variants remain readable at small scale.

deliverables.purpose: 徽章工艺特写图，强调边缘、材质与节制点缀色。
deliverables.acceptance_test: Macro badge closeup uses deep-ink, tongji-blue, signal-coral, paper-white; caption + mono appear cleanly; result reads as official lab merch not fashion jewelry.

deliverables.purpose: 帆布袋、笔记本、徽章三类周边总览合影。
deliverables.acceptance_test: All three merchandise categories appear together with unified use of paper-white, tongji-blue, deep-ink, steel-grid, signal-coral; display + headline + caption hierarchy stays consistent.

deliverables.purpose: 周边在同济校园环境中的应用图，强化学校归属与访客展示属性。
deliverables.acceptance_test: Uses an official campus photo as image_edit reference; shows at least one merch item clearly; uses paper-white, deep-ink, tongji-blue, campus-green; campus scene remains believable and Tongji-grounded.

deliverables.purpose: 单个自包含策展页面，汇总最终 PNG、设计系统上下文与研究出处。
deliverables.acceptance_test: Embeds every required PNG; inline CSS only; no JS; top section shows palette swatches and typography role callouts from design_system.json; sections are Tote, Notebook, Badge, Collection, Campus, and a secondary Research Provenance block.
